about_the_game:
Meet the ALife; mysterious, charming beings who survive by consuming ore.

This 30-minute demo offers a brief but immersive glimpse into their endearing yet sometimes frustrating lives unfold.

While features such as costume customization, auto-camera, and volume adjustment are not available in this version, the core experience remains fully intact.

If you're curious about their world, we invite you to enjoy this unique glimpse into their lives.
